title: Heat test (P-068): set up the phone before it starts
instructions: Please set: Auto-Lock Never; Auto-Brightness off with a fixed brightness; Low Power Mode off; leave True Tone, Night Shift, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth as they are; close other apps. Lay the phone flat in its usual spot (same surface, same case), on the cable, and don't touch it during the test (two sessions of about 1 h). Keep the room and air conditioning as they are now.
